card.name: Last piece of drug name before overdose
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name that is split into several parts, right before the word overdose, poisoning or overexposure. It appears in overdose sections of drug labels, often with treatment or dialysis wording.

modes.label: Drug name ending before overdose
modes.description: The last piece of a long generic drug name, directly followed by overdose or overdosage.
modes.example: The effectiveness of hemodialysis in the treatment of vigabat<<rin>> overdose is unknown.

modes.label: Before poisoning or overexposure
modes.description: The ending of a drug name followed by poisoning or overexposure instead of overdose.

card.writes: It boosts words for harm events such as poisoning, errors, accidents and injuries, so the next word is likely to be overdose or poisoning.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a drug's name when the next word is expected to be overdose or poisoning.
